title: Freedom Yield Metal — Operator Identity Manifest v1
description: Formal contract for /api/identity.json. Revised 2026-06-20 as a pre-production correction; see docs/IDENTITY_SCHEMA_CHANGELOG.md for the full history. The model is an operator-signed artifact snapshot WITHOUT a P-Chain anchor (the prior P-Chain memo binding was abandoned because the current Avalanche / Metal protocol rules forbid non-empty memos on AddPermissionlessValidatorTx). The runtime manifest is generated and signed by scripts/operator-local/gen-identity.sh on the operator's local Mac, NEVER on the validator host or web host. Verification uses ssh-keygen -Y verify with namespace freedom-yield/validator-identity. Companion /api/identity.example.json is a synthetic schema example, NOT a production snapshot. Companion design changelog: docs/IDENTITY_SCHEMA_CHANGELOG.md. The schema URL is a stable discovery endpoint; consumers that need immutable schema semantics SHOULD pin the schema document SHA-256 or the repository commit (see CHANGELOG). A future breaking change will use a new major-version schema URL; retention and deprecation policy for superseded schema versions will be documented when such a version is introduced.

node_id_authority.description: Authoritative explorer URL where the NodeID's registration can be cross-checked.

site.description: Canonical site URL the operator controls.

operator_identity_pubkey_url.description: URL where the operator identity ed25519 public key is published (typically /.well-known/operator-identity.pub).

operator_identity_pubkey_fingerprint.description: OpenSSH SHA-256 fingerprint of the operator identity public key, e.g., 'SHA256:abc123…'. A consumer can compute the same fingerprint via 'ssh-keygen -l -f operator-identity.pub' and compare.

key_iat.description: When this operator identity key was issued (became authoritative).

key_exp.description: Recommended expiry; operator-declared, NOT cryptographically enforced. Consumers may treat as policy.

revoked.description: true iff this key is no longer authoritative for the brand+node_id. When true, revoked_at + revocation_reason SHOULD be populated.

artifact_manifest.description: Merkle-rooted artifact manifest: each entry binds a leaf artifact's URL to its content sha256, and (where applicable) its schema URL and schema sha256. A consumer fetches each entry's url, computes sha256(content), and compares to entry.sha256. The set is committed to as a whole by artifact_root (see below). Additive: new artifacts may appear in this map within v1.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the artifact's raw bytes as published.

artifact_root.description: SHA-256 Merkle root computed over artifact_manifest entries: leaves are each entry.sha256, ordered alphabetically by key, odd counts duplicate the last leaf, parents are SHA-256(left || right) as raw bytes, hex-encoded at the root. In identity.example.json this field is set to all-zeros (sixty-four '0' characters) to indicate the schema-only preview state; the production runtime identity.json carries the real 64-hex Merkle root after gen-identity.sh computes it from the live artifact bytes.
